section.title: Keys
section.subtitle: Anthropic API keys and Claude Code OAuth tokens.
section.removeBody: Remove {{label}}? The stored secret will be deleted from the system Keychain. This can’t be undone.

toasts.copiedShell: Copied shell command for {{label}} ({{preview}}) — clipboard clears in 30s.

list.apiDesc: Console-issued sk-ant-api03-… keys. Usage reports are not available per-key via the public API.
list.apiEmpty: No API keys yet. Create one in your <consoleLink>Anthropic console</consoleLink>, then paste it here.
list.oauthEmpty: No OAuth tokens yet. Run claude setup-token and paste the value into “Add key”.
list.shellColTitle: Copy a paste-ready terminal command (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN='…' claude). Launches Claude Code with this token in a new terminal without disturbing your current login.
list.accountRemovedTitle: The account this key was created under has been removed.
list.viewUsageCached: View cached usage (linked account has been removed)

addModal.title: Add key
addModal.mustStartWith: Must start with sk-ant-api03- or sk-ant-oat01-
addModal.pickAccount: Pick the account this key was created under
addModal.labelHint: A short name you'll see in the list.
addModal.tokenHint: Paste the full value. We detect the kind from its prefix.
addModal.unknownPrefix: Unknown prefix. Expected sk-ant-api03- (API key) or sk-ant-oat01- (OAuth token).
addModal.hintNoAccounts: No registered accounts yet — add one from the Accounts section first.
addModal.hintOauth: The account you were signed in as when you ran claude setup-token.
addModal.hintApi: The Anthropic account that owns this API key in the console.
addModal.hintDefault: Defaults to your active CLI account.

usageModal.title: Usage · {{label}}
usageModal.noCached: No cached usage for this account yet. Open the Accounts section to refresh.
usageModal.noWindows: No usage windows reported for this token yet.

vault.title: Secret vault
vault.desc: Local named secrets — stored at rest on this machine only. Copy one out, or inject it into a project's .env from that project's detail view.
vault.deleteBody: Remove {{name}} from the vault. Projects that already have this value in their .env keep it — only the vault copy is deleted.
